name: Hôtel Jeanne d'Arc Le Marais
summary: A 3-star the hotel itself presents as an economical stay in the Marais, on rue de Jarente.
description: Hôtel Jeanne d'Arc Le Marais is at 3 rue de Jarente, in the 4th. The hotel’s own site calls the house a 3-star and puts the emphasis on a central Marais address rather than a grand lobby. That is the brief Lina is hunting: a room with a sense of place, and a rate you confirm on Booking.com instead of taking our word for it.
